notes.title: Just Updated!
notes.content:
Finish the 7 Pillars story! Use your current saves and find the rest of the relics and prepare for the final fight against Aisa. 

This update is free to those who already purchased the game and will be included at the regular purchase price for anyone new who purchases the game.

notes.title: NEW CONTENT AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Recently updated to extend the 7 Pillars story. In this small update, you will start to uncover more about what is going on and need to find the first two Relics (out of six) that will be needed to defeat Ethos and Aisa once and for all. 

Use your current save files to continue the 7 Pillars story. More content to come!

This update is free to those who already purchased the game and will be included at the regular purchase price for anyone new who purchases the game.
